decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the side wall of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 4 - The garage accommodation shown on drawing VS 1204/3 shall not be used for any purpose other than the parking of vehicles without prior written consent from the Council.

Condition : 5 - INFORMATIVE
Attention is drawn to the fact that part of the development hereby approved falls within the adjoining local planning authority, Spelthorne Borough Council. It will therefore be necessary for a separate planning application to be made to Spelthorne Borough Council.
description: Erection of two storey side extension incorporating integral garage and one new parking space.
